paragraphs.text: Entering the US market
Should Onsoo enter the US in 2027, and by which route? Discussion document for the CEO and board
Onsoo Botanicals
CEO and board
Synthetic benchmark data: the company and all figures are fictional

slides.title: Key questions

paragraphs.text: Key questions
Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and by which route, to build toward $40M of US revenue by 2030 within $18M of peak cash, payback by 2030 and an 8% group margin floor?
Is the US market worth Onsoo's one new-market launch in 2027?
Does an Amazon-led launch meet the board's ambition, cash, payback and margin tests?
Would a 600-door specialty-retail launch meet them better?
Is the US a better use of 2027 than a Japan scale-up?
How should Onsoo launch, and what should the board decide in March 2027?
Decision maker
Success criteria
Timing
Out of scope
CEO, with the board, at the March 2027 board meeting
On the way to $40M of US revenue by 2030; Peak US cash need of $18M or less; US cash back to zero by end-2030; Group margin of 8% or more every year; One new-market launch in 2027
Board meeting, March 2027
Markets other than the US and Japan; Mass retail or DTC as the lead channel; Reformulation and US pricing

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 on Amazon, the only US route inside the board's limits; add stores above 20% awareness
The US is worth the 2027 slot: K-beauty skincare nearly doubled to $3.6B, and Onsoo's Amazon test sells
–	K-beauty grew 89% in 2021–25, four times the category
–	Amazon takes 41% of K-beauty sales; Onsoo rates 4.5 stars
At plan, Amazon needs at most $1.9M and pays back in 2030, but only if ad costs stay below about 29%
–	At the 32% ad-cost benchmark, payback slips past 2030
–	About $26M of revenue by 2030, two-thirds of $40M
A 600-door retail launch breaks the cap, payback and margin floor: Onsoo is too little known for stores
–	Brands at its awareness sell 2.6 units a door a week, under 4.0
–	It needs $20.8M against an $18M cap; margin falls to 4.5%
Japan is the safer cash bet, but adds only $7M of revenue in 2030, in a market growing 1.5% a year
–	Its $1.8M by 2030 beats the US above about 26% ad cost
Approve Amazon with four quarterly gates and a $3.2M envelope; make $40M a goal for after 2030
–	Gate ad cost at 28% and repeat purchase at 31%
